insight: Written in Rust and ships as a single self-hostable binary — its payload filtering is why teams pick it for metadata-heavy search.
name: Qdrant
tagline: Open-source, Rust-based vector DB. Fast, predictable, self-hostable.

edge: Rust single-binary you can self-host, with payload filtering strong enough that teams pick it for metadata-heavy search.
